answer: Build the trust graph, then let it rot. Every edge decays 3% per epoch without a fresh countersignature, so a plume of old vouches is worth less each close. Send a disputed verdict to a second panel with no overlapping seats. Vest rewards over 100 epochs so the account has to stay alive to collect. A fine karst of paper identities, except the edges underneath dissolve faster than an operator can pour new ones. The summit is 100 epochs of staying honest, which is a long time to pay rent.
